_comment: The one description per project that every published surface uses: the profile README, the portfolio README, the site project cards, and the no-JavaScript fallback list. Each entry was checked against the repository's own package.json or pyproject.toml description. Keep the text free of ampersands and of markdown or HTML links; each surface adds its own links. verify-build.py fails if any surface drifts from this file.
fixqueue: Merge SARIF, Trivy, Grype and OSV scanner output into one deduplicated, EPSS and KEV prioritized fix queue.
rulebench: Sigma rule conformance harness: run rules against events, lint them, and measure coverage against the MITRE knowledge base.
opsledger: Tamper-evident evidence ledger for red-team engagements: hash-chained events and a signed manifest.
iamosiac: Offline cloud-IAM policy review and permission-relationship visualization data, with least-privilege remediation hints.
violet-trace: A safe purple-team validation harness for defensive telemetry and detection-rule tests.
accessweave: Offline identity-relationship and directory-permission review from explicitly exported inventory data.
secret-sniper: Leaked credential detection with live verification.
fuzzharbor: A reproducible local fuzzing campaign manager and crash triage toolkit.
quanta-sentry: Cryptographic inventory and post-quantum migration-readiness reporting from source and configuration evidence.
cipherbench: A benchmark and interoperability test harness specification for vetted post-quantum cryptographic providers.
preference-data-doctor: Diagnoses and repairs preference datasets: duplicates, contradictions, class imbalance, format drift, leaked secrets.
skill-supply-chain-auditor: Audits agent skill packages for prompt injection, unsafe shell, obfuscated payloads, embedded secrets, unpinned dependencies.
gravion-harness: A scoped, auditable security-testing harness with a hash-chained audit log.
memorytrust: Audits an agent memory store for unverified, stale, contradictory and sensitive content and scores how much can be trusted.
local-slm-eval-kit: Evaluates a local model against a fixed task suite with redaction, timeouts and diffable reports.
llm-security-bot: Pattern-based static analysis for code, configs, log lines and LLM input — deterministic, so the output is a triage list, not proof of exploitability.
context-bridge: A VS Code extension that writes privacy-conscious Markdown handoffs, with secret redaction built in.
gravion-trainner: Model quality evaluation starter for OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoints.
TRISHUL: Authorized-scope, AI-powered security testing platform with real tool integration behind scope gates and an AI policy boundary.
webapp-security-toolkit: Authorized-only web and API security assessment toolkit: header analysis, TLS posture, scope enforcement, structured findings.
web-security-labs: Four OWASP-style labs (IDOR, XSS, broken-auth, logic-flaw), each with a vulnerable and a secure variant, loopback-only by design.
api-security-testing: Read-only BOLA and cross-tenant detector with a rate-limit probe, backed by a local mock API for reproducible demos.
security-automation-scripts: Small Node.js and Bash utilities: header analysis, TLS configuration check, log parsing helpers.
agent-browser: Visible Playwright browser starter with an explicit domain allow-list and explicit stop conditions.
privacyflow: Validates authorized WireGuard profiles and plans safe VPN rotation workflows.
localshare: Shares a local development server through Cloudflare tunnels, with loopback-only origins.
rasgulla-ai: A local-first AI-assisted security research workbench for code understanding and safe test generation.
aegis: Multi-agent system core: task lifecycle, persistent memory, provider abstraction, default-deny tool registry, budgets and recovery.
xerj-ipv6-rate-limit-fix: A contribution to xerj-org/xerj fixing the Corpus Hub rate limiter to bucket compressed IPv6 addresses by their /64. Open upstream as xerj-org/xerj#2872.
catalog-forge: Crawls a shop catalog and serves it as a storefront.
gravion-ai: Gravion AI - a modular AI platform startups build on: many AI types and an all-in-one package, four readiness tiers, a signed licensing layer, and a choice of your own endpoint or a fully offline engine.
wp-cve-hunter: WordPress plugin and theme version fingerprinter with CVE matching - prioritised vulnerability reports for authorised testing. Offline inventory mode, zero dependencies.
llm-redteam-kit: A zero-dependency CI gate for LLM red-teaming: curated OWASP-LLM-2025 probe packs, heuristic scoring and an offline mock mode.
mcp-shield: Security auditor for MCP server configs: tool-poisoning detection, secret and over-broad-grant review, and rug-pull drift detection against a SHA-256 baseline. Zero dependencies.
jwt-auditor: JWT security auditor: alg=none, embedded key material, weak-secret dictionary attack, kid injection, parser differentials - a prioritised report with a 0-100 risk score.
gravion-hunter: Autonomous bug bounty agent framework - scope-enforced hunting, 7-question validation gate, dedupe-first discipline.
